title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - Threshold
description: A threshold base entity containing threshold rules. (TM Forum TMF649 Performance Thresholding 5.0.0, OpenAPI component Threshold; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:Threshold:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Threshold'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'Threshold' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Addressable/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:Threshold:<tmfId>. unique identifier

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Threshold/properties/description'. A description of the threshold

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Threshold/properties/name'. A word, term, or phrase by which a Performance threshold is known and distinguished from other thresholds.

thresholdRule.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Threshold/properties/thresholdRule'. A Performance Threshold contains a set of Performance threshold rules of different conditions (Raise, Clear) and different severities. In TMF this is an array of ThresholdRuleRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced ThresholdRule entities (urn:ngsi-ld:ThresholdRule:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.
